description: Laotian Times describes Xaysettha constituents from three villages meeting elected representatives about compensation and prices, but the meeting’s date, public/protest character and simultaneous attendance are unreported. Do not treat three villages as three events or as an attendance count.
required_followup: A permitted report with meeting date, public character and attendance or corroborating contemporaneous event coverage.

description: Laotian Times article on the March 24 Sihom night-market closure was found in search results; exact URL body open returned a tool timeout `(400) Timeout fetching` without an HTTP response. Search snippet says vendors were told to close and notes dissatisfaction but does not describe a gathering. A distinct April 6 RFA body reports a planned market closure around April 25 and vendor dissatisfaction, but no public protest; this timeline does not resolve the March 24 snippet. The March target was not retried.
required_followup: No retry of the Laotian Times URL. If future work addresses a public vendor action, use distinct permitted contemporaneous evidence and resolve closure timing.
